meaning.hi: इसी नाम से इसे निकट जाना और सम्मानित किया जाना चाहिए

meaning.en: whoever understands it in this way
meaning.hi: जो कोई इसे इस प्रकार समझता है

meaning.en: all living beings naturally long to draw near to them
meaning.hi: सभी प्राणी उसके निकट जाना चाहते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: 'please teach me the essential secret teaching'
meaning.hi: 'कृपया मुझे सार-रहस्य सिखाइए'

meaning.en: the secret teaching has been told to you
meaning.hi: यह गुप्त शिक्षा तुम्हें बताई जा चुकी है

words.sanskrit: brahmim vava te upanishadam abrumah iti

meaning.en: we have declared to you the secret teaching about Brahman itself
meaning.hi: हमने तुम्हें ब्रह्म के बारे में यह गुप्त शिक्षा बताई है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tasyai tapah damah karma iti pratishtha

meaning.en: its foundation is austerity, restraint, and rightly performed action
meaning.hi: इसकी नींव तप, संयम और सम्यक् कर्म है

meaning.en: the Vedas are its many limbs
meaning.hi: वेद इसके अंग हैं

meaning.en: truth is its dwelling place, its abode
meaning.hi: सत्य इसका निवास स्थान है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever understands this in the way it has been described
meaning.hi: जो कोई इसे इस प्रकार समझता है

meaning.en: having shed every trace of wrongdoing
meaning.hi: हर दोष को मिटाकर

meaning.en: becomes firmly established in the vast, unending, supreme world
meaning.hi: उस विशाल, अंतहीन, सर्वोच्च लोक में दृढ़ता से स्थापित हो जाता है

meaning.en: firmly established indeed (repeated to mark the close of the teaching)
meaning.hi: दृढ़ता से स्थापित (शिक्षा के अंत को चिह्नित करने के लिए दोहराया गया)
